scope: fresh-store setup admission and generation invalidation
properties: the pre-reset installation generation is captured as setup evidence but cannot be reused
the reset journal generation replaces the fresh bootstrap generation before runtime activation
only the current security policy, guard mode, assistant allowlist, projects, assignments, sharing rules and active profile identities are restored
custom native profile identities are admitted through the existing control repository with deterministic idempotent operations
profile admission revokes earlier fresh-generation contexts and produces only new setup workflow requests
old policy history, sources, derivatives, learned state, approvals, schedules, effect receipts and workflow history are not copied
exact replay returns the same generation, setup and profile admissions; conflicts fail closed
limitations: This verifies setup admission into fresh stores; Docker lifecycle orchestration, native preference restoration and the complete empty-baseline proof remain pending.
No live installation data, credentials, services or Telegram state were changed.
